title: Reporte de Producción · Superenvases
description: Reporte horario por máquina y turno. Elija fecha, turno, tipo de máquina y máquina en los selectores. Para descargar: menú de cada panel › Inspect › Data › Download CSV (activar «Download for Excel»). Los datos para descargar (sección plegable al final) usan «Descarga: máquinas» y «Descarga: periodo», contado desde la fecha del turno elegida.

options.content: Elija fecha, turno, tipo de máquina y máquina en los selectores. Para descargar datos: menú de cada panel › **Inspect › Data › Download CSV** (activar «Download for Excel»). La sección **Datos para descargar**, al final, usa «Descarga: máquinas» y «Descarga: periodo» (contado desde la fecha del turno elegida).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT hour_label AS "Hora", production AS "Producción" FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}' AND machine = '${maquina}' ORDER BY slot
SELECT hour_label AS "Hora", ${chart2:raw} FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}' AND machine = '${maquina}' ORDER BY slot

panels.title: Producción total (latas)

targets.rawSQL: SELECT coalesce(sum(production), 0) AS "Valor" FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}' AND machine = '${maquina}'

SELECT 0 AS min, CASE '${maquina}' WHEN 'p11' THEN 792000 WHEN 'p31' THEN 1440000 WHEN 'p32' THEN 1440000 WHEN 'di11' THEN 192000 WHEN 'di12' THEN 192000 WHEN 'di14' THEN 192000 WHEN 'di15' THEN 192000 WHEN 'di17' THEN 192000 WHEN 'di18' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum31' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum32' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum33' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum34' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum35' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum36' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum37' THEN 192000 WHEN 'standum38' THEN 192000 WHEN 'minster_l1' THEN 84000 WHEN 'minster_l3' THEN 84000 WHEN 'ispray11' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray12' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray13' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray14' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray15' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray31' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray32' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray33' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray34' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray35' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray36' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray37' THEN 192000 WHEN 'ispray38' THEN 192000 ELSE 192000 END AS max

panels.description: Máximo del indicador = capacidad nominal de la máquina × 12 horas (D&I y STANDUM: 16.000 latas/h, sin capacidad nominal configurada). Rojo < 50 %, amarillo 50–80 %, verde ≥ 80 % de ese máximo.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT coalesce(${g2:raw}, 0) AS "Valor" FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}' AND machine = '${maquina}'
SELECT 0 AS min, CASE '${tipo}' WHEN 'DI' THEN '50' WHEN 'STANDUM' THEN '50' WHEN 'PRINTER' THEN '1500' WHEN 'ISPRAY' THEN '100' WHEN 'MINSTER' THEN '12' END AS max
SELECT coalesce(${g3:raw}, 0) AS "Valor" FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}' AND machine = '${maquina}'
SELECT 0 AS min, CASE '${tipo}' WHEN 'DI' THEN '50' WHEN 'STANDUM' THEN '50' WHEN 'PRINTER' THEN '20000' WHEN 'ISPRAY' THEN '12' WHEN 'MINSTER' THEN '100' END AS max

panels.title: Detalle horario del turno · ${maquina} · ${fecha} ${turno:text}

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ${cols:raw} FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}' AND machine = '${maquina}' ORDER BY slot

panels.description: Columnas según el tipo de máquina, como en el Reporte de Streamlit. Fila de totales al pie. Observaciones: naranja = incidencia registrada en planta, amarillo = parada automática, gris = sin producción. Descargar: menú del panel › Inspect › Data › Download CSV.

panels.title: Datos para descargar · «Descarga: máquinas» y «Descarga: periodo»
Detalle por hora (una fila por máquina y hora)

targets.rawSQL: SELECT shift_date AS "Fecha turno", CASE shift WHEN 'day' THEN '6AM-6PM' ELSE '6PM-6AM' END AS "Turno", date_format(hour_start_local, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS "Hora inicio (planta)", hour_label AS "Hora", line AS "Línea", machine_type AS "Tipo", machine AS "Máquina", production AS "Producción", short_cans AS "Latas cortas", trimmer_jams AS "Tranc. trimmer", scrap_kg AS "Merma (kg)", scrap_pct AS "% Merma", efficiency_pct AS "% Eficiencia", downtime_min AS "Tiempo parada (min)", retrac AS "Retrac", blow_off AS "Blow off", golpes_bobina AS "Golpes bobina", golpes_turno AS "Golpes turno", observations AS "Observaciones" FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE machine IN (${descarga:singlequote}) AND (('${periodo}' = 'turno' AND shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}') OR ('${periodo}' = 'dia' AND shift_date = '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = '7d' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date('${fecha}') - interval '6' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = '30d' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date('${fecha}') - interval '29' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = 'mes' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date_trunc('month', date('${fecha}')), '%Y-%m-%d') AND '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = 'mes_ant' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date_trunc('month', date('${fecha}')) - interval '1' month, '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_trunc('month', date('${fecha}')) - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d'))) ORDER BY hour_start_utc, machine LIMIT 50000

panels.description: Periodo: «Descarga: periodo», contado desde la fecha del turno elegida. Máquinas: «Descarga: máquinas». Descargar: menú del panel › Inspect › Data › Download CSV (activar «Download for Excel»). Máximo 50.000 filas: para rangos largos, filtrar máquinas.

panels.title: Totales por turno y máquina

targets.rawSQL: SELECT shift_date AS "Fecha turno", CASE shift WHEN 'day' THEN '6AM-6PM' ELSE '6PM-6AM' END AS "Turno", line AS "Línea", machine_type AS "Tipo", machine AS "Máquina", count(*) AS "Horas", sum(production) AS "Producción", sum(short_cans) AS "Latas cortas", sum(trimmer_jams) AS "Tranc. trimmer", round(sum(scrap_kg), 2) AS "Merma (kg)", round(avg(efficiency_pct) FILTER (WHERE production > 0), 2) AS "% Eficiencia (horas activas)", sum(downtime_min) AS "Tiempo parada (min)", sum(retrac) AS "Retrac", sum(blow_off) AS "Blow off" FROM polar_production.production_hourly WHERE machine IN (${descarga:singlequote}) AND (('${periodo}' = 'turno' AND shift_date = '${fecha}' AND shift = '${turno}') OR ('${periodo}' = 'dia' AND shift_date = '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = '7d' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date('${fecha}') - interval '6' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = '30d' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date('${fecha}') - interval '29' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = 'mes' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date_trunc('month', date('${fecha}')), '%Y-%m-%d') AND '${fecha}') OR ('${periodo}' = 'mes_ant' AND shift_date BETWEEN date_format(date_trunc('month', date('${fecha}')) - interval '1' month, '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_trunc('month', date('${fecha}')) - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d'))) GROUP BY shift_date, shift, line, machine_type, machine ORDER BY shift_date, shift, line, machine_type, machine

panels.description: Descargar: menú del panel › Inspect › Data › Download CSV.
